title: External reference circuit benchmark
content: Original machine-readable transcriptions, independent analytical expectations, own MCP preview gallery and sanitized native numerical validation report; no original source images or raw private logs.
source_image_rights: Unestablished; source images are not redistributed.

layout_modes.reference_guided: case.circuit_spec: 20-unit component placements and external port positions; no mandatory node anchors or explicit routes.
layout_modes.automatic: case.automatic_circuit_spec: identical components, ports and analysis; compact density and rail/local ground style only.

polarity_contract.I: nodes=[from,to], positive current first→second; native current export signs are checked separately.
polarity_contract.passive_current_oracles: Physical from/to nodes, without assuming native exported current signs.

execution_policy: Every SCM construction and native calculation used the official MCP SDK stdio client. No UI automation. See validation-report.json for passed checks and disclosed native transient timeouts.
visual_policy: Topology, numerical agreement, reference-guided fidelity and automatic visual quality are separate gates. Hand placements alone do not establish generator consistency.

final_dc_node_voltage.scope: Final native voltage samples for supported DC-copy fixtures; not a separate native DC solver call.

transient_output_voltage.scale: max(1 V,abs(ideal output at requested stop time))
transient_output_voltage.exclude: Source rise interval and first timestep

not_separately_measured: Physical current values/directions in case metadata are analytical expectations; this harness does not assert current export columns.
Standalone phase examples are analytical expectations; AC acceptance reconstructs complex voltage from native magnitude/phase.
tolerances.status: These are the actual applied harness rules; no standalone current or phase tolerance is claimed.
